data.name: Jawshan
data.gender_notes: Jawshan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jawshan is an Arabic name that signifies 'Armour of the Heart'. It's a powerful name with deep spiritual significance, often associated with protection and strength. The name Jawshan carries the meaning “Armour of the Heart” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawshan usually hope their child will grow to embody armour of the heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Jawshan is believed to be the armour worn by Prophet Yusuf (Joseph). It symbolizes divine protection and unwavering faith.
data.etymology: Jawshan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Armour of the Heart.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawshan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
